task: Listen to the teacher explaining a warm-up game. Explain the rules back in your own words, then say what you would do first.
say: Okay, everyone in a circle. One at a time, say your name and do a move with it, like a wave or a jump. Then we all copy your name and your move together.
zh: 听老师讲解一个热身游戏。用自己的话把规则复述一遍，再说说你会先做什么。

task: Listen to the teacher explaining a warm-up game. Explain the rules back in your own words, then say what you would do first.
say: Let's pass a clap around the circle. Turn to the person next to you, look at them, and clap at the same time. Then they turn and pass it on. Try to keep it fast.
zh: 听老师讲解一个热身游戏。用自己的话把规则复述一遍，再说说你会先做什么。

task: Listen to the teacher explaining a warm-up game. Explain the rules back in your own words, then say what you would do first.
say: Walk around the room and fill the empty spaces. When I say a number from one to five, change your speed. One is super slow, five is as fast as you can safely go.
zh: 听老师讲解一个热身游戏。用自己的话把规则复述一遍，再说说你会先做什么。

task: Listen to the teacher explaining a warm-up game. Explain the rules back in your own words, then say what you would do first.
say: Find a partner and stand face to face. One of you leads and moves slowly. The other is the mirror and copies everything at the same time. Then we swap.
zh: 听老师讲解一个热身游戏。用自己的话把规则复述一遍，再说说你会先做什么。

task: Listen to the teacher explaining a warm-up game. Explain the rules back in your own words, then say what you would do first.
say: This one is Zip Zap Zop. Clap your hands toward someone and say zip. They pass it to someone else with zap, then the next person says zop, and we start again with zip. If you say the wrong word, that's fine, just laugh and keep going.
zh: 听老师讲解一个热身游戏。用自己的话把规则复述一遍，再说说你会先做什么。

task: Listen to the teacher explaining a warm-up game. Explain the rules back in your own words, then say what you would do first.
say: Close your eyes. As a group, we're going to count to twenty. Anyone can say the next number, but if two people speak at the same time, we go back to one.
zh: 听老师讲解一个热身游戏。用自己的话把规则复述一遍，再说说你会先做什么。

task: Listen to the teacher explaining a game. Explain the rules back in your own words, then say what you would do first.
say: Anyone can shout an idea, like, let's be firefighters! Everyone else shouts yes, let's! and acts it out straight away. Then someone else gives a new idea.
zh: 听老师讲解一个游戏。用自己的话把规则复述一遍，再说说你会先做什么。

task: Listen to the teacher explaining a game. Explain the rules back in your own words, then say what you would do first.
say: We're going to tell a story one word at a time. I'll say one word, the person on my left says the next word, and so on around the circle. Don't plan ahead, just add the next word that makes sense.
zh: 听老师讲解一个游戏。用自己的话把规则复述一遍，再说说你会先做什么。

task: Listen to the teacher explaining a game. Explain the rules back in your own words, then say what you would do first.
say: In pairs, give your partner an imaginary gift. Show its size and weight with your hands, but don't say what it is. Your partner opens it, says thank you, and decides what it is.
zh: 听老师讲解一个游戏。用自己的话把规则复述一遍，再说说你会先做什么。

task: Listen to the teacher explaining a game. Explain the rules back in your own words, then say what you would do first.
say: We'll build a story around the circle. The first person starts with fortunately and says something good. The next person starts with unfortunately and says something bad. Keep switching.
zh: 听老师讲解一个游戏。用自己的话把规则复述一遍，再说说你会先做什么。

task: Listen to the teacher explaining a game. Explain the rules back in your own words, then say what you would do first.
say: Two lines. The first person mimes an action, like brushing their teeth. The next person asks, what are you doing? You must answer with something totally different, like I'm walking a dog. Then they have to do that.
zh: 听老师讲解一个游戏。用自己的话把规则复述一遍，再说说你会先做什么。

task: Listen to the teacher explaining a game. Explain the rules back in your own words, then say what you would do first.
say: In this scene, you can only speak in questions. If you make a statement, pause, or repeat a question, you're out and the next person takes your place.
zh: 听老师讲解一个游戏。用自己的话把规则复述一遍，再说说你会先做什么。

task: Listen to the teacher explaining a game. Explain the rules back in your own words, then say what you would do first.
say: Two people, three lines only. Person A says one line, person B answers, and person A says one more line. In those three lines, try to show who you are, where you are and what's happening.
zh: 听老师讲解一个游戏。用自己的话把规则复述一遍，再说说你会先做什么。

task: Listen to the teacher explaining a game. Explain the rules back in your own words, say what you would do first, and ask one question about a rule you are not sure of.
say: This is an alphabet scene. The audience gives a letter, and the first line must start with that letter. Each new line starts with the next letter of the alphabet, until you've gone all the way round back to the first letter.
zh: 听老师讲解一个游戏。用自己的话复述规则，说说你会先做什么，并就一条你不确定的规则提一个问题。

task: Listen to the teacher explaining a game. Explain the rules back in your own words, say what you would do first, and ask one question about a rule you are not sure of.
say: Two people start a scene. Anyone watching can shout freeze. The actors stop in their positions. You tap one actor out, take their exact position, and start a completely new scene from that shape.
zh: 听老师讲解一个游戏。用自己的话复述规则，说说你会先做什么，并就一条你不确定的规则提一个问题。

task: Listen to the teacher explaining a game. Explain the rules back in your own words, say what you would do first, and ask one question about a rule you are not sure of.
say: You'll do a normal scene, but every time I ring the bell, I'll call out an emotion, like jealous or excited. You keep the same story, but now you play it with that emotion.
zh: 听老师讲解一个游戏。用自己的话复述规则，说说你会先做什么，并就一条你不确定的规则提一个问题。

task: Listen to the teacher explaining a game. Explain the rules back in your own words, say what you would do first, and ask one question about a rule you are not sure of.
say: Four of you stand in a line. I'm the conductor. When I point at you, you tell the story. When I point at someone else, they continue from your exact word, even in the middle of a sentence.
zh: 听老师讲解一个游戏。用自己的话复述规则，说说你会先做什么，并就一条你不确定的规则提一个问题。

task: Listen to the teacher explaining a game. Explain the rules back in your own words, say what you would do first, and say how you would handle the hardest part.
say: One of you is a world expert on a strange topic the audience chooses, like the history of socks. The other is a TV host who interviews you. The expert must answer every question with total confidence, even when they have no idea.
zh: 听老师讲解一个游戏。用自己的话复述规则，说说你会先做什么，再说说你会怎样应对其中最难的部分。

task: Listen to the teacher explaining a game. Explain the rules back in your own words, say what you would do first, and say how you would handle the hardest part.
say: One person is hosting a party and leaves the room. The guests each get a secret quirk, like they think they're a cat. The host comes back, chats with each guest, and has to guess everyone's quirk.
zh: 听老师讲解一个游戏。用自己的话复述规则，说说你会先做什么，再说说你会怎样应对其中最难的部分。

task: Listen to the teacher explaining a game. Explain the rules back in your own words, say what you would do first, and say how you would handle the hardest part.
say: Two people pretend to show holiday photos. The others jump into frozen poses to make each photo. The presenters must explain each photo as if they planned it, even when the pose makes no sense.
zh: 听老师讲解一个游戏。用自己的话复述规则，说说你会先做什么，再说说你会怎样应对其中最难的部分。
